review.assessment: The diff introduces `keep_present` using a manual index-based loop that conditionally appends elements where `if v:` evaluates to true. This implementation drops all falsy values rather than strictly filtering out only `None`, directly violating the requirement to keep everything else. It also falls short of the 'cleaner and more Pythonic' goal by relying on manual indexing instead of direct iteration or a list comprehension.

findings.defect: Incorrect filtering of falsy values: `if v:` drops all false-like inputs instead of only `None`.
